Rail Glide.name: Rail Glide
Rail Glide.description: The user wraps their boots and palms in live magnetic coils and rides the pull along steel rails, girders, pipes or parked cars across a street or up a building face. They can carry one passenger and brake against steel below to turn a fall into a soft landing. Running current and pull together leaves the user's legs tingling and wipes cards and phones on both riders, and wooden or stone faces give no lift. Strain: moderate.
